skills.name: scientific-chart-style
skills.description: Create or restyle publication-quality scientific charts in any discipline. Pick one of 19 chart types from an index, read only that chart's card (inputs, statistical definition, example), and render it with editable SVG/PDF and PNG exports. Saturated blue palette by default, with a purpose-built grayscale mode for print.

skills.name: scientific-presentation-style
skills.description: Build scientific PowerPoint slides in the scientific-chart-style look: white canvas, saturated blue/orange/purple, projection-size type, and editable native charts, tables and plot geometry that keep their statistical meaning. Use for research presentations and chart- or table-focused PPT requests; not for journal figure sizing or unrelated slide branding.

skills.name: research-progress-report
skills.description: Draft or revise self-contained scientific progress reports for public briefings or lab meetings, including 科研进展报告、阶段性研究总结、项目进度汇报. Explains the work from an overview down to the evidence in plain language, and documents model data splits, architecture, losses, training, checkpoint selection and evaluation in full. Not for journal manuscripts or grant proposals.

skills.name: infohub-maintenance
skills.description: Maintain an existing InfoHub research workspace: project datasets, previews, annotations, local snapshots and exports, report delivery, and the unified Web/MCP services. Optional integration for people who already run InfoHub; ordinary research never needs warehouse publication, and the writing and chart skills don't need InfoHub.
